name: Making Friends
source:
A lonely witch finally completes her prized creation after years of mischievous preparation... and it's cuter than she ever imagined! Follow her, her homunculus, and a forgotten friend in this informative course about emotions and magic.

[Edited from [url=https://autumnotopia.itch.io/making-friends]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位孤独的女巫经过多年的恶作剧准备终于完成了她珍贵的创作……而且它比她想象的更可爱！跟随她、她的小人以及一位被遗忘的朋友，学习这门关于情感和魔法的信息丰富的课程。

[编辑自[url=https://autumnotopia.itch.io/making-friends]itch.io[/url]]
